part.text:
Implemented incremental builds and caching for the SSG:

**`src/cache.ts`** (new) — SHA-256 hashing for files/directories, plus load/save/delete for the `.ssg-cache.json` manifest (versioned, so an incompatible format is treated as no cache).

**`src/engine.ts`** — `SsgEngine` now accepts `incremental`, `clean`, and `cacheFile` options. Each build hashes the content file and the whole templates directory (layouts + partials count as one invalidation unit, since partials can be shared across layouts); the plugin pipeline names are also fingerprinted so a config change invalidates stale entries. Unchanged pages reuse their cached `Page` (skipping the whole `onFile` plugin chain — markdown parsing, frontmatter parsing, etc.); changed/new pages rebuild and get a fresh cache entry with a recorded build time. Results include a `stats` object: `pagesBuilt`, `pagesSkipped`, `totalPages`, `durationMs`, `timeSavedMs`.

**`src/plugin.ts`** — `PluginContext` gained an optional `incremental.unchangedSourcePaths` set, additive and backward-compatible (plugins that ignore it behave exactly as before).

**`plugins/template.ts`** — `TemplatePlugin` skips re-rendering/rewriting a page's HTML file when it's in the unchanged set and the output file already exists, avoiding redundant Handlebars renders and disk writes. `index.html` is still always regenerated since it depends on all pages and is cheap.

**`src/cli.ts`** — added `--incremental` and `--clean` flags to `ssg build`; prints a stats line (`N built, M skipped (T total) in Xms, ~Yms saved`) when `--incremental` is used. Cache defaults to `<outputDir>/.ssg-cache.json` (already covered by the existing `dist/` gitignore rule).

**`src/generator.ts` / `src/index.ts`** — threaded the new options/types through and exported them.

Tests added: `tests/cache.test.ts` (hashing/manifest persistence), `tests/incremental.test.ts` (skip/rebuild correctness on source changes, added/removed files, template changes, `--clean`, plugin-signature invalidation, and that the plugin architecture is untouched — `onFile` still runs for every page in non-incremental mode and is skipped only for cached pages), `tests/cli-incremental.test.ts` (CLI flag wiring and stats output).

All 85 tests pass (52 pre-existing + 33 new), and `tsc` / `npm run build` compile cleanly with no changes to existing behavior when `--incremental` isn't passed.
